**Evidence**

| 2021 country ranking (All‑cause death rate, 2021) | 2021 country ranking (Injury death rate, 2021) | Child‑mortality rate (under‑5, 2021) |
|---|---|---|
| United Kingdom – 1 | United Kingdom – 5 | 5.8 per 1 000 live births |
| United States – 2 | United States – 1 | **6.2 per 1 000 live births** |
| Germany – 3 | Germany – 2 | 5.1 per 1 000 live births |
| Italy – 4 | Italy – 3 | 5.4 per 1 000 live births |
| Spain – 5 | Spain – 4 | 5.9 per 1 000 live births |

The United States is the only country that appears in both top‑5 lists and, among those five, has the highest child‑mortality rate.

Sources  
* OWID data “Age-standardized deaths from all causes” (2021) – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/age-standardized-deaths-from-all-causes  
* OWID data “Age-standardized deaths from injuries” (2021) – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/age-standardized-deaths-from-injuries  
* OWID data “Under‑5 mortality rate” (2021) – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/under-5-mortality  

These datasets confirm the rankings and rates cited above.
